name: Harvey Elliott

career_stints.note: Debut season only (EFL Cup and Premier League cameos), aged 15-16 -- he became the youngest player in Premier League history at the time. Left for Liverpool in July 2019. No goals or assists recorded in this brief debut season.
Season-long Championship loan from Liverpool; nominated for EFL Young Player of the Season.

All-competitions Liverpool career total through 2024/25 (excludes the 2020/21 Blackburn loan season, itemized separately above), before his September 2025 loan to Aston Villa. Assists total not reliably verifiable across sources, omitted rather than guessed. In 2023/24 specifically (his last full Liverpool season): 53 all-comp appearances, 2783 minutes, 4 goals, 11 assists (34 PL apps, 3 goals, 6 assists), used as playstyle_metrics.source_season below.

Season-long loan with an obligation-to-buy clause (~$47m/£35m), reported motivation being World Cup contention. Villa's manager did not want to sign him permanently and he featured sparingly; Premier League split: 4 appearances, 211 minutes, 0 goals, 0 assists. The obligation was not triggered and he returned to Liverpool for 2026/27 pre-season under new manager Andoni Iraola.

notes: Used his 2023/24 Liverpool season (his last full, healthy, non-loan season: 53 apps, 2783 minutes, 4 goals, 11 assists all-comp) as playstyle_metrics.source_season rather than the unproductive 2025/26 Aston Villa loan, since 211 Premier League minutes on loan at a club that ultimately declined to sign him permanently is too thin and unrepresentative to be a meaningful positional/style sample -- the same judgment call made for Isak's 2024/25 Newcastle season vs. his injury-disrupted Liverpool debut (see data/player_profiles/isak_alexander.json).

No per-90 advanced metrics (shots/90, xG/90, pass accuracy, progressive passes, touches, duels won%) could be verified from an accessible source for the 2023/24 season -- left null rather than guessed.

2023/24 positional note: reporting from that season describes him used mainly as a central midfielder (23 apps) but also as a right winger and impact substitute (9 starts from 22 appearances) -- consistent with his current single squad-listed position of AM but worth flagging as more fluid than a single tag suggests.

Sources: liverpoolfc.com, thisisanfield.com, anfieldwatch.co.uk, liverpool.com, sports.yahoo.com, statmuse.com, anfieldindex.com, theanalyst.com, sportskeeda.com, transfermarkt.us -- via web search 2026-08-10.
